QF.id: SIA Logic Model for Social Programs_47

question.text: Ms. Sunita Patil has signed an AIR whose LFM fails basic SMART tests at both outcome and output levels. Which body has the primary oversight jurisdiction over her conduct as an SIA?

answer.text: ICMAI — Institute of Cost Accountants of India
ICAI SIAB (Social Impact Assessment Standards Board) — the notified SRO for SIAs, which empanels SIAs and issues the SAS standards applied to her engagement

explanation.text: The Logic: ICAI SIAB (Social Impact Assessment Standards Board) is the notified SRO for SIAs, empanelling them and issuing SAS-100 through SAS-1600 standards. ICMAI is NOT the SRO for SIAs. A SIA who signs off on an LFM failing basic SMART tests at material levels exposes herself to ICAI SIAB disciplinary review. The Trap: A (ICMAI) is explicitly wrong per XXIII Ch 2. C (RBI) and D (IRDAI) regulate banking and insurance respectively, not SIAs. Cross-Exam Context: Tested across XXIII Ch 2 (Ecosystem) and Ch 7 (SAS). Parallels apply in III-A/III-C Compliance for listed-entity oversight. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Maintain a personal engagement file with your SMART/OVI test evidence per row. If called to explain an AIR, that file is your first-line defence with ICAI SIAB.
